title: Thinking procedurally: ordering subprocedures
intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: decomposition — Split a problem into smaller operations.
subprocedure — Named step used within a larger solution.
dependency — Stage that must precede another.
state update — Change the stored record or value.
transaction — Coordinated operations that must succeed reliably.

blocks.title: Decompose the task
blocks.text: Separate the problem into input validation, checking availability, updating the record and notifying the user.

blocks.title: Identify dependencies
blocks.text: No booking should be saved until seats are available; no confirmation should be sent before a successful save.

blocks.title: Make smaller operations reusable
blocks.text: ValidateRequest and SendConfirmation can become independently testable subprocedures.
